items.name: Ink Black
items.role: The brand's only conversion colour. Every primary CTA pill, the footer fill, every dark promo band, every nav login button. The system has no secondary accent.

items.name: Surface Pressed
items.role: The pressed-state fill for white pills — a soft grey that's used only in active / pressed states.

items.name: Black Elevated
items.role: A near-black used on hover for the translucent white tab-toggle pill. Documented as a system colour because it appears on a recurring brand control.

items.name: Canvas Soft
items.role: The soft gray fill for category chips, form-input rows inside the ride-request card, and subtle pill buttons.

items.name: Canvas Softer
items.role: A slightly lighter gray used as a nested-input fill on white surfaces.

items.name: Ink
items.role: Every heading and body paragraph on light surfaces.

items.name: Body
items.role: Secondary text — captions, sub-headings, supporting copy.

items.name: Hairline Mid
items.role: A mid-gray used for muted link text inside footer columns and breadcrumb-style nav.

items.name: Mute
items.role: The lightest text role — placeholder text, fine print, low-priority metadata.

items.name: On Dark
items.role: All text on surfaces (footer, dark promo bands).
